zh:
宾夕法尼亚大学（University of Pennsylvania，简称宾大、UPenn）成立于1749年，位于美国宾夕法尼亚州费城，是美国第四古老的高等教育机构，也是常春藤盟校成员之一。学校下设12个学院，在校生超26000人，覆盖医学、商学、法学、工程、教育、护理等全领域。
宾夕法尼亚大学由美国开国元勋本杰明·富兰克林创立，是现代美国高等教育的先驱之一，培养了34位诺贝尔奖得主、17位普利策奖得主、8位菲尔兹奖得主。学校的沃顿商学院是全球第一所商学院，长期稳居世界商学院排名榜首，在金融、管理等领域具有全球影响力。2026QS世界大学排名中，宾夕法尼亚大学位列世界第15位。
en: The University of Pennsylvania (UPenn) is a private research university in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, United States. Founded in 1749 by Benjamin Franklin, it is the fourth-oldest institution of higher education in the United States and a member of the Ivy League. The University comprises 12 schools, with over 26,000 enrolled students, excelling in medicine, business, law, engineering, education, and nursing. UPenn has produced 34 Nobel Prize winners, 17 Pulitzer Prize winners, and 8 Fields Medalists. Its Wharton School is the world's first collegiate business school, consistently ranked No.1 globally. Ranked No.15 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
